regions.name: The Wardens' Lodge
regions.blurb: Rangers, gate-wardens and hearth folk of the great oaks. They keep the roads and the hunt.

regions.name: The Coven
regions.blurb: The witches' hollow: candle, cauldron and thorn, and everything stitched or brewed in it.

regions.name: The Hushwood
regions.blurb: The old deep wood and what grew up in it — fae, dryads, wyrmblood and worse.

regions.name: The Mistway
regions.blurb: River, bog and grey coast: the ferrymen, tollkeepers and drowned things of the water.

regions.name: The Hanging City
regions.blurb: The timber city on its stilts: guilds, garrison, trades and the stage.

regions.name: The Ossuary
regions.blurb: The bone lands under the old skull: the dead, the debts and the ones who collect them.

regions.name: The Frostfell
regions.blurb: The winter north: ice, raiders, the long walk and the wyrm.

regions.name: The Ironmarch
regions.blurb: Forge and powder: smiths, bombards and the coal that feeds them.

regions.name: The Far Shores
regions.blurb: From beyond the wood entirely — other worlds, other stories, washed up here.
